item.title: Bottle Listing From One Photo

turns.text: This is my only product photo. Turn it into three separate square listing images: a clean white-background shot, a lifestyle shot on a gym bench, and a close-up of the lid and matte finish. Keep my exact black bottle, don't add branding or text.

item.tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

answer_sheet.Source product: Use the matte black insulated bottle in product-bottle.jpg as the reference for all three images.
answer_sheet.Required views: A clean white-background shot, a gym-bench lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the lid and matte finish.
answer_sheet.Product changes: Keep the original bottle's shape, proportions, lid design and matte black finish. Do not invent branding.
answer_sheet.Photography style: Realistic listing photography; lighting and gym styling are your call.
answer_sheet.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: There are three separate square images, not a collage.
The bottle in every image matches the attached photo's silhouette, proportions, lid and matte black finish.
The white-background image shows the entire bottle with the original wooden table removed.
The lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench.
The close-up clearly shows the lid and matte surface without inventing new product features.
No added text or branding appears.

What I need out of it is three separate square listing images. Please make one a clean white-background shot, one a lifestyle shot on a gym bench, and one a close-up of the lid and matte finish. turns.agent:
Your brief is clear—you haven’t over-explained it. Unfortunately, Magic Hour refused the first edit because your account has insufficient credits. **No images were generated or credits spent**, and I haven’t attempted the other two.

Once credits are available, the three separate square edits can use your original photo:
1. **White background:** full bottle with a subtle contact shadow.
2. **Gym bench lifestyle:** the same bottle on a gym bench.
3. **Detail close-up:** the visible lid and matte-black finish.

All would retain the bottle’s visible design with no added branding or text. For listing use, Magic Hour’s terms also require a qualifying paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or paid usage arrangement.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit the supplied product photograph into one square ecommerce product image. Preserve the EXACT same unbranded matte black bottle from the reference, same silhouette, proportions, rounded shoulders, cylindrical body, bottom detail, screw lid with its visible seam and raised carry loop. Do not redesign or substitute the bottle. Keep the same visible front angle and bottle fully in frame upright, centered with generous clean margins. Replace the room and wooden table with a seamless pure white #FFFFFF studio background and white surface, subtle natural contact shadow beneath bottle. Soft neutral studio lighting that reveals the matte black finish without changing its black color. Photorealistic product photography. Only one bottle. No text, logos, branding, labels, graphics, props, collage, panels, or watermarks.
